subject: HelixCare VPC: sudden 5xx + p95 latency surge — mitigation & tuning request
messages:
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@helixcare.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@helixcare.com, carmen.li@helixcare.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: (urgent) production degradation — tokenization service (private VPC)

Neha —

We're seeing a sharp regression in the private VPC deployment that rolled yesterday evening. Key symptoms:
- p95 response time jumped from ~420ms to ~2.3s starting ~00:40 UTC;
- 5xx rate increased to 4.8% across inference endpoints (500/502/504);
- overall throughput dropped ~28% despite steady request volume.

This follows your agent update pushed at 23:15 UTC (Redwood runtime v2.9.1). We're attaching a cluster snapshot and logs. Our platform team has quarantined a couple of nodes but we need Redwood on-call to help triage and propose immediate mitigations — we can't afford continued errors for our triage workflows.

Attachments: helixcare_p95-spike-20270321.png, svc-logs-20270321.tar.gz

Please advise next steps and any immediate fallbacks (model variant, concurrency changes, rollback) you recommend. We also need a short RACI and an estimate for when this can be resolved.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Director, Platform Engineering
HelixCare
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@helixcare.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, ops@helixcare.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (urgent) production degradation — tokenization service (private VPC)

Rajiv —

Thanks for the heads up and for the logs — got them. Sorry you're seeing this. I'm escalating this to our runtime and support leads and we'll run a short mitigation plan now. High-level immediate options:
1) Roll back the runtime agent to v2.9.0 (safe path) — low risk if you can allow a short maintenance window.
2) Temporarily divert traffic to the quantized model variant (less memory pressure) — fast but may slightly change output characteristics.
3) Apply KV cache increase + throttle per-worker concurrency to reduce eviction churn (config change, no image change).

I've looped in Dylan (SE) for quick config changes and Markus (runtime) for kernel/batch tuning. Stephanie will coordinate customer comms and credits if needed.

Could you confirm:
- Are you open to a 15–30 minute maintenance window for rollback tonight?
- Any compliance/maintenance approvals required on your side to allow our engineers temporary bastion access?

We will run the following: collect a sampling of KV cache hit/miss stats, test a controlled rollback in canary, and stand up the fallback model variant if rollback isn't possible. I'll update in 20 minutes with a clearer plan.

— Neha
Senior Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
From: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@helixcare.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (urgent) production degradation — tokenization service (private VPC)

Rajiv / team — quick technical readout from the logs you shared:
- Observed contention in KV cache eviction during bursts; miss rate up from 2% to 18% between 00:40–01:10 UTC.
- Several GPU workers show elevated memcpy stalls (kernel scheduling) coincident with longer seq lengths in the latest job mix.
- There are also a handful of 504s originating from the request queue saturating worker threads (long tail due to KV misses).

Immediate safe actions (can do <30 mins if HelixCare approves):
- Action A (rollback): revert runtime agent to v2.9.0 for the affected node pool (canary 10% -> 100% in 10-minute increments). This is the lowest-risk path.
- Action B (config change): increase kv_cache.size from 12GB -> 20GB on nodes with >48GB RAM and reduce max_concurrency from 16 -> 10. No binary change; rolling config update.
- Action C (fallback): route 20% of traffic to quantized-8bit variant (same model family) while we observe error rate.

Commands (for ops) — example:
- To increase KV cache: REDWOOD_KV_CACHE_SIZE_GB=20 ./redwood-agent apply-config --target nodepool-tokenize
- To rollback agent: ./redwood-agent rollback --image redwood/runtime:v2.9.0 --target nodepool-tokenize --canary 10

If rollback is permitted we'll start with canary. If not, we'll apply Action B immediately. I'll prepare a short runbook and a diff of the config changes.

— Dylan
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@helixcare.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (urgent) production degradation — tokenization service (private VPC)

Quick runtime note: I reviewed kernel traces and scheduling logs. Two follow-ups are required beyond the config change:
1) Adjust the GPU kernel selection for attention kernels on the affected nodes (we saw a fallback to the generic kernel in the last build). Patch: runtime/patches/attention-kernel-hotfix-20270321 (I can apply remotely).
2) Increase worker prefetch queue and enable soft-prefetch for sequences >1024 to reduce memcpy stalls.

Constraints: for 1) we need SSH access to the bastion and a short maintenance window (I estimate 20–30 minutes for deploy + verification). For 2) the config change is low risk and we can roll in 5–10 minutes.

Proposed mitigation plan (sequence):
T0 — Apply config change (kv_cache + concurrency) across pool (5–10 min)
T1 — Start canary rollback to v2.9.0 (if approved) and measure p95/error delta (10–20 min)
T2 — If canary fails or rollback not allowed, flip 20% to quantized variant and apply kernel hotfix under maintenance window (20–30 min).

I'll prepare the kernel patch and a brief verification script. If HelixCare approves remote access, I can target the patch this afternoon in the maintenance window.

— Markus
Runtime Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Carmen Li <carmen.li@helixcare.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@helixcare.com>, ops@helixcare.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 11:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (urgent) production degradation — tokenization service (private VPC)

Neha / Markus / Dylan —

We can approve a maintenance window today 13:30–14:00 PDT and we will provide bastion access for the maintenance. Please confirm expected customer impact and if there will be any request routing changes that require our firewall/ingress updates.

Also: our VP of Eng wants an exec-level 30-minute sync after mitigation to review root cause and credits. Please include estimated mitigation time and any service credits you plan to propose (we have a renewal conversation next quarter).

Carmen
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform — HelixCare
From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Carmen Li <carmen.li@helixcare.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@helixcare.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: (urgent) production degradation — tokenization service (private VPC)

Thanks — we confirm the maintenance window 13:30–14:00 PDT and will proceed with the lowest-impact path:
- T0 (13:30): Apply config change (kv_cache 12->20GB + reduce concurrency). Expected customer impact: none (transparent config update).
- T1 (13:40): Start a 10% canary rollback to runtime v2.9.0 for tokenization nodepool; monitor for 20 minutes. Expected customer-visible improvement if the regression is due to the agent.
- T2 (13:55): If canary does not reduce p95/5xx, flip 20% traffic to quantized variant and apply kernel hotfix during the final 5–10 minutes (some short tail errors possible).

We'll provide live metrics (p95, error rate, KV hit rate) to your ops channel and open a HubSpot update (link below). After mitigation we'll schedule the 30-minute executive sync for RCA and credit discussion.

Doc links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/HC-2471 — I have also attached a short maintenance acknowledgement (pilot_kpi_snapshot.csv) and will send a DocuSign for formal maintenance approval if you prefer.

Thanks for the quick approval — Dylan and Markus will be on the call. Stephanie will coordinate the exec sync.

— Neha
Senior Sales Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: pilot_kpi_snapshot.csv
